description: This PHP source file defines the LoggerTransform class, a utility class for transforming strings in the context of logging, including escaping HTML tags and handling CDATA sections. It is part of the log4php logging framework.
external_files: the parent directory included via the LOG4PHP_DIR define

classes.name: LoggerTransform
classes.description: A utility class for transforming strings to be safely included in logs, handling HTML tag escaping and CDATA section processing.

methods.name: escapeTags
methods.description: Replaces '<' and '>' characters in the input string with their entity references to prevent HTML injection or rendering issues.

methods.name: appendEscapingCDATA
methods.description: Ensures that embedded CDATA end markers (]]>) are properly escaped within message strings to maintain well-formed XML.
